events.title: The Demo Is Here!
events.summary: I'm very thankful for everyone who's experienced the Alpine Lake Demo! Almost 1000 of you have played and I've been listening to all the feedback I've come across! Here are some updates to the demo. Stamina Usage: The stamina system has been rebalanced to provide a less punishing experience. No longer will stamina be used when you miss a tree with your axe, or a stone with your pick axe.
